datum_caveat: Elevations below are raw SRTM (EGM96-referenced). The 0.81m empirical offset found during SAR-edge calibration was based on an unverified proxy event and was NOT confirmed against a real observed river level. Treat any elevation near the 49.68m/48.68m thresholds as having +/- ~1m uncertainty until the datum question is formally resolved against a real CWC gauge reading.
